prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE independent full-body run-cycle sprite for character17, SW, frame2/16. 30ms per frame, 480ms two-step loop. NEW independent articulated running pose using identity/style references ONLY; reference1 idle pose is NOT the target pose. Reference1 fixes exact character identity, SW camera, costume and anatomical prop ownership. Reference2 is PRIMARY approved Q Daoist painted style, ignore UI.
Direction/camera: SOUTHWEST, running toward lower-left and slightly toward viewer, three-quarter front-left camera exactly like input1. Both eyes visible, nose/gaze/body axis points lower-left; do not turn pure side or straight front. Foreshorten forward/back legs along the diagonal travel axis.
Forward/backward below means relative to travel direction. Exact phase: LEFT compression: LEFT planted knee bends deeply under the forward body to absorb landing, LEFT sole grounded; RIGHT leg folds behind with heel rising. Hips 20px lower. RIGHT brush elbow begins retreating from forward swing, LEFT scroll elbow begins coming forward.
Show actual running anatomy: both knees and shoes separately readable, forward leaning short torso, natural opposite-arm shoulder/elbow swing, stable wrists and props following the gripped hands. No straight locked arms or fixed display pose. Keep head large with short compact limbs. Blank hanging scroll tilts with LEFT wrist motion but stays held; exactly TWO pale-cyan ink spirits stay distinct beside it, moving with scroll without blocking the two shoes. RIGHT hand always holds same large black-shaft brush, white-black bristles opposite BUTT with ONE teal tassel attached. LEFT hand always holds ONE blank ivory scroll with black/gold rods and ONE lower-rod yin-yang teal tassel. No hand swapping.
Identity: messy short brown hair/high topknot, yin-yang hair clasp, plain teal cloth ribbon with no added tassel, tiny jade forehead diamond, gold-brown eyes, charcoal robe with warm gold cloud trim, ivory lining, jade belt/yin-yang buckle and established pendants only. Full short boots.
Production framing: 1254x1254 square RGBA, native at least1024. Character HEAD diameter excluding bun about440px across all frames. Fixed root x640, virtual ground y1155; camera/scale fixed, do NOT align airborne feet back onto ground. Preserve flight lift. Entire character/brush/scroll/tassels/spirits with generous margin. No viewpoint change, ground shadow, scene, text, labels, rune, effect, motion-blur, speed-lines, extra limb, multi-panel sheet, image mirroring, copy/warp/interpolation. True transparency with clean anti-aliased local-color edges; no red/yellow/green contamination, cyan/white matte or checkerboard. Return exactly ONE sprite. Costume continuity: charcoal trousers fully cover BOTH legs down to the boots; NO skin below belt, NO shorts, NO new kneepad, cloud emblem or golden badge on knees. Preserve plain dark trousers.  Anatomical mapping in this front-left three-quarter view: RIGHT brush shoulder/hip are on viewer-left, LEFT scroll shoulder/hip on viewer-right. When LEFT leg leads, it originates at viewer-right hip and reaches lower-left in perspective while RIGHT leg folds behind; when RIGHT leg leads, it originates at viewer-left hip. Opposite arm must lead, not same-side arm and leg.
